summary: Host only; nothing was flashed, run or written on the phone. An instruction-level interpreter (capstone decode, own execution, stage-1 table walker) runs the real payload kernel bytes from the entry with the loader's boot_args layout and the window measured in native run 007 (base 0x9de400000, size 0x20000000). With an empty XNULDRST slot it falls through the five assembly checkpoints, builds the bootstrap tables, enables the MMU and returns into arm_init (8202 instructions). With the slot filled it stops at each of the five assembly checkpoints with x0=x1=0, x2=2, x3=N, MMU off, and a resuming-stub model chains 1,2,3,4,5 and reaches arm_init in the same state as the uninterrupted run. A C stop at checkpoint 10 faults (NULL PE_state.bootArgs); the first safe C checkpoint is 11. The interpreter itself is cross-checked against Unicorn. Model, not hardware: no caches, TLB, devices, SIMD, timing or exception vectoring.
